# RANDOM.ORG

> RANDOM.ORG provides true random number generators and randomization tools powered by atmospheric noise for scientific, educational, and practical applications.

RANDOM.ORG is a trusted platform offering multiple specialized random generators including integer generators, list randomizers, dice rollers, and lottery quick picks. The site serves researchers, educators, and decision-makers who need cryptographically secure randomization based on genuine atmospheric noise rather than algorithmic pseudorandom generation.
